reviews.q: Tim's crew redid our kitchen and fixed a few things we'd been putting off for years. Clear quote, steady progress, clean site.
New tile floors and fresh paint through the whole house. They showed up when they said they would and finished on time.
Built us a patio cover just before summer. Fair price and great communication the whole way.
